As a big fan of Fantasy Premier League and a true believer in AI technology, this website is built as an experimental research project applying AI to FPL squad forecasting. It uses multiple AI models to forecast every player's points and ensemble them for each gameweek. Best Team solves a fresh optimization problem each gameweek for the single best possible squad within budget; Team AI plays a full persistent season with real transfers, budget, and chip strategy.

If you don't already know what FPL is, check out the official game at fantasy.premierleague.com — it's a genuinely exciting game for soccer fans, don't miss out!

All FPL names, player photos, and club crests belong to the Premier League. This website does not claim any ownership or copyright over them.
